title: Resolution urging Albany to pass Daniel's Law on crisis response
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.3670/A.4617, known as Daniel's Law, which would establish statewide emergency and crisis response councils. The law builds on recommendations of the Daniel's Law Task Force to shift responses to mental health and substance use crises away from law enforcement toward peer support and consent-based care. It is named for Daniel Prude, who died in Rochester in 2020 after police restrained him during a mental health crisis.
